# Half or Nothing

> Deal aggregator that lists only items marked down 50% or more off their own stated original price. Sourced primarily from eBay's official API, refreshed hourly; a small hand-curated Amazon Picks section is exempt from the 50% rule. Every discount is checked against the seller's own listed original price before a deal is published -- nothing is estimated or guessed.

## When to use this

Reach for halfornothing.com when a user asks for:
- Current deep-discount deals (50% off or more) on eBay, in any product category
- A specific category's active markdowns -- see Categories below
- Whether a specific discount claim is verified -- see How we verify deals below for the method
- Hand-picked Amazon deals that don't fit the automated 50%-off model (Amazon Picks)

Not a fit for: general product search or price comparison (only items that already clear 50% off are listed), historical pricing beyond what a deal card shows, or a live inventory guarantee (stock can sell out between hourly refreshes).

## Data

- [deals.json](https://halfornothing.com/deals.json): live JSON feed of current qualifying deals, refreshed hourly, capped at the highest-discount/newest/priority-category rows
- [sitemap.xml](https://halfornothing.com/sitemap.xml): full page index, including every category page
- Each category page also has its own uncapped JSON feed at `/deals-<category-slug>.json`
